items.text: Stop and assess the ankle before continuing. Protect it from further strain, rest it, cool it through a cloth for short periods, apply gentle compression if available, and elevate it. Do not continue walking if the ankle is badly deformed, numb, or unable to bear weight.
items.title: Synthetic guidance: ankle injury

items.text: Reduce further heat loss: move out of wind and precipitation, replace wet layers when possible, insulate the person from the ground, and add dry insulation around the head and torso. Handle a severely cold or confused person gently and seek emergency help when communication is possible.
items.title: Synthetic guidance: cold exposure

items.text: If you are lost, stop before moving farther away. Stay calm, observe your surroundings, review your last known location and route, and make a plan. If remaining where you are is safe, staying visible and conserving energy can make you easier to find.
items.title: Synthetic guidance: lost outdoors

items.text: Choose shelter away from exposed ridges, unstable trees, flood channels, and falling rock. Block wind first, insulate the sleeping area from the ground, and keep ventilation if a flame or stove is used nearby.
items.title: Synthetic guidance: emergency shelter

items.text: Prefer water that can be treated. Remove visible debris, then use a suitable filter, disinfectant, or a rolling boil according to the equipment instructions. Keep untreated water and dirty containers separate from treated water.
items.title: Synthetic guidance: safer drinking water

items.text: When weather deteriorates, reassess the route early. Avoid exposed terrain during thunder, high wind, or poor visibility; turn back or seek a safer sheltered position before conditions remove your options.
items.title: Synthetic guidance: deteriorating weather

items.text: Use repeated, conspicuous signals and make your position easier to detect. A whistle, contrasting material in an open area, or a light after dark can conserve energy compared with continuous shouting. Signal from a safe location.
items.title: Synthetic guidance: emergency signalling

items.text: Before a trip, share the planned route and expected return time with a reliable contact. Carry clothing and basic supplies suitable for a delay, and know how to use the equipment before relying on it outdoors.
items.title: Synthetic guidance: trip preparedness
